item.title: Missile strike kills 2 IDF soldiers during rescue mission in southern Lebanon
item.description: An IDF soldier, Sgt. 1st Class Maher Khatar from Majdal Shams, was killed in a missile strike on troops conducting a rescue mission at a southern Lebanon outpost. A second soldier also fell in the incident, and Israeli Air Force jets struck multiple targets in response. item.title: Antisemitic terror in Belgium: explosive device detonates outside synagogue in Liège
item.description: A bomb detonated before dawn outside a synagogue in Liège, Belgium, destroying its facade and shattering nearby windows.
